title: 📊 Project configuration

messages.content:
Generate responses following these rules:
1. Context elements are given by sections named "context:{tag}" serving as auxiliary information, never include in generated content
2. Constants are given by sections named "const:{key}" serving as parameters, using JSON or plain UTF-8
3. Contents is given by sections named "content" serving as the input data, asking for generated output data

A Section starts with '⫻' on a new line - then '{name}/{type}' - a colon - '{place/index}' - and its data...
1. 'name' being a keyword or token: ['const','content','context']
2. 'type' being optional information: format, encoding, component type
3. data as indicated
4. a few empty lines until the end of the section

⫻const/config:project_config:1
{
"project_name": "QtAssist",
"language": "Python",
"framework": "PyQt5",
"dependencies": ["ollama"]
}

⫻context/meta:project_description:1
This project aims to develop a multi-assistant group chat (like IRC) using Ollama.

## Project Overview

This project, **QtAssist**, is a multi-assistant group chat application, developed using **Python** and the **PyQt5** framework. It integrates the **Ollama** library to enable an interactive and engaging group chat experience, similar to IRC. 

## Project Description

**QtAssist** aims to create a feature-rich and user-friendly group chat platform, enhanced by the presence of multiple conversational assistants. Users will be able to interact with each other and the assistants seamlessly, creating a unique and dynamic chat environment. 

## Key Features

- Multi-assistant integration: QtAssist will support multiple conversational assistants, allowing users to interact and engage with a diverse range of AI personalities.
- Group chat functionality: The application will facilitate group conversations, enabling users and assistants to participate in dynamic and engaging discussions.
- User-friendly interface: PyQt5 provides a robust and flexible framework to design an intuitive and visually appealing user interface, ensuring a seamless user experience.
- Customization options: Users will have the ability to personalize their chat experience, including customizing their avatars, themes, and notification preferences.
- Assistant personality customization: QtAssist may also explore the possibility of allowing users to customize the personalities and responses of the integrated assistants, adding a layer of personalization to the group chat dynamic.

## Target Audience

QtAssist targets individuals who are seeking a unique and interactive group chat experience. It combines the convenience of a traditional group chat platform with the engaging presence of conversational assistants, creating a novel and entertaining way to connect and communicate.

## Conclusion

With its combination of multi-assistant integration, group chat functionality, and a user-friendly interface, QtAssist has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact and engage in group conversations. The project aims to provide a dynamic and entertaining chat experience, enhanced by the presence of multiple assistants, each bringing their unique personality and contributions to the discussion.
